verdict.rationale: Versioning, reviewing, and rolling back automations is a fair question for an analytics platform with workflows, but the evidence never documents version history, review/approval, or rollback for any automations. The nearest items, turning off a feature flag [amplitude-docs-19] and managing flags from CI via the Experiment APIs [amplitude-docs-13], are adjacent release-control features, not automation versioning, so they earn no credit.
